episodes.task_summary: Harden GitHub Actions workflow deploy.yml: pin actions and restrict token permissions

observations.summary: Security review flagged deploy.yml: unpinned third-party actions and default write-all GITHUB_TOKEN permissions
deploy.yml used the pull_request_target trigger and checked out the pull request head

attempts.action_summary: Validated the workflow syntax with `actionlint .github/workflows/deploy.yml`
Added a top-level `permissions:` block granting only `contents: read`, raising scopes per job only where needed
Pinned every third-party `uses:` reference to a full 40-character commit SHA with the release tag in a trailing comment
Replaced `pull_request_target` with `pull_request` so untrusted pull request code never runs with repository secrets
Re-ran `actionlint .github/workflows/deploy.yml` to confirm the hardened workflow is valid

evidence.summary: CI run of the hardened deploy.yml succeeded and actionlint exited 0

criteria: every third-party action pinned to a commit SHA

lessons.problem: Workflow uses unpinned actions and broad token permissions
lessons.successful_approach: Validate with actionlint, add least-privilege permissions, pin actions to SHAs, avoid pull_request_target for untrusted code, re-validate
contraindications: workflow consumes actions from an internal mirror that rewrites refs
lessons.confidence_basis: CI run of the hardened workflow
